These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Assumptions, units and boundaries Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed. Editorial clarification The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible. Adopted numerical method Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states. ∂tψ=−sx(ψ+Dxu),DxPMLu=Dxu+ψ∂t​ψ=−sx​(ψ+Dx​u),DxPML​u=Dx​u+ψ ψn=bψn−1+c(Dn+Dn−1),b=1−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2,c=−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2ψn=bψn−1+c(Dn+Dn−1),b=1+sx​Δt/21−sx​Δt/2​,c=1+sx​Δt/2−sx​Δt/2​ ΔEmod+Wphysical−WPML=0ΔEmod​+Wphysical​−WPML​=0 References and measured quantities Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.
